svg.title: Deploy, Test, Then Call
svg.desc: In your project, pick a model in the model catalog and deploy it, setting the deployment name, type, version and tokens-per-minute (TPM) limit; deploying doesn't train the model. Test it in the playground with instructions and parameters, compare models side by side and use View code. The app then calls the deployment by name. From the playground you can optionally save it as an agent. When the app gets HTTP 429, a capacity problem: if quota is left, raise TPM within quota; if not, cut max tokens or concurrency. Changing temperature, or switching to a Developer deployment, which is only for evaluating fine-tuned models, does not fix 429.
svg.text: A deployment is the phone line apps dial by name; the playground is the test call.
Changing temperature, or switching to a Developer deployment (only for evaluating fine-tuned models)
